name: pi-ai
summary: pi-ai is a TypeScript library that gives one API for calling LLMs from about 40 providers, plus any OpenAI-compatible endpoint. It streams typed events for text, thinking and tool calls, tracks tokens and cost per response, and can hand a conversation off to another model mid-session. It is the model layer of the Pi agent harness, but runs on its own as a client library rather than a proxy.
facts: ~40, plus any OpenAI-compatible endpoint (Ollama, vLLM, LM Studio)
Tool calling (TypeBox), unified reasoning option, cost tracking, cross-model hand-off
Yes, it is an in-process library
goodFor: TypeScript agents that switch models mid-session
No extra proxy hop between app and provider
watchOut: Library, not a gateway: no central keys, budgets or logs
Keys must be passed explicitly in the browser
